verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing pages list custom monitoring policies with instant alerts and remote script execution, and describe automated remediation of recurring fixes across endpoints. Together these suggest a product-native ability to trigger actions on monitored events, but the claims are thin and undocumented in detail. missing for 10: documentation of how users define event→action rules (trigger types, conditions, action binding), evidence that policies can fire scripts or remediations automatically rather than only alerting, depth of the rule engine, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Reduce manual workload by automating recurring fixes.
